sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: The ordinary naming question specifies a water-resistant coat for rainy weather. RAINCOAT mainL40 and kidsL101 positively give waterproof/water-resistant coat. The conventional Russian name Дождевик fits; Блуза, Рубашка and Свитер are familiar top categories rather than names of this coat type. A fabric treatment or occasional use outside does not rename those garments as a raincoat. No parka/trench is an answer here; the retained synonym list’s trench is relevant as context, not an unlisted competing key.
